c113.title: Max makes a game
c113.story: Max and his friend Oleh dream of becoming [[game developers|game developer]]. This year, they finally start their own small project. Max's cousin Ira joins as [[project manager]], and a classmate joins as one more [[dev]]. Together they make an [[RPG]] about a magic forest. The hero is a small [[hobbit]] who travels with a brave [[elf]]. On the way, they fight an [[orc]], a sneaky [[goblin]] and a slow, angry [[ogre]]. Later they meet an old [[mage]] who has no [[mana]] left. The [[gameplay]] is simple, but their friends love it. Before the game starts, players choose their own [[avatar]]. After a month, a hundred people download the game, and Ira orders pizza for everyone.

c114.title: Uncle's poker night
c114.story: Max's uncle Petro invites his friends for a [[poker]] night. They play with plastic chips, and in their house rules the [[joker]] can replace any card. Uncle Petro tries a big [[bluff]] and goes [[all-in]]. But his neighbor calmly shows a [[full house]]. "You're a real [[hustler]]!" Uncle Petro laughs and hands over all his chips. Then he tells long stories about a [[casino]] trip many years ago. He played [[blackjack]] all night and lost everything. "[[Gambling|gambling]] is not for me anymore," he says. "I never won a [[jackpot]], not once." Grandma shakes her head. "You're a [[gambler]], Petro. Play [[pinball]] instead!"

c116.title: Max goes viral
c116.story: Max films a funny [[video]] of his cat, Bublyk. It is long, so he cuts a short [[video clip]] from it. He drags the [[clip]] onto the [[timeline]] and adds music. Then he shares it in a [[post]] online. The next day, it is a [[meme]] and a city [[trend]]. People add a [[tag]] with the cat's name. His classmate writes a [[tweet]] about it. The [[hype]] grows every day. A pet shop offers a [[giveaway]] for his fans. Then Max shares a [[how-to]] about a kitchen [[hack]] for cat owners. He also makes a [[playlist]] of songs for cat lovers. Bublyk does not care and just sleeps on the keyboard.

c119.title: Meeting a superstar
c119.story: Sofia is a [[finalist]] in a TV talent show. After her song, a talent [[scout]] gives her a card. "I work in [[show business]]," he says. "People call it [[showbiz]] for short." Backstage, Sofia sees a real [[celebrity]]. He is a famous [[superstar]] and a rich [[playboy]]. A big [[bodyguard]] stands next to him. [[VIP]] guests talk about [[glamour]] and fast cars. Outside, the [[paparazzi]] take hundreds of photos. Then girls from her school [[fan club]] run to Sofia. They ask for her [[autograph]], not his!

c120.title: A day at the zoo
c120.story: On Saturday, Anna takes her little brother Taras to the zoo. First, they see a big [[tiger]] and a quiet [[gorilla]]. A mother [[orangutan]] holds her baby, and a [[gibbon]] swings above them. "They are all [[primates|primate]], like us," Anna says. The [[panda]] eats bamboo, and a [[zebra]] runs in the sun. A [[leopard]] sleeps on a high branch. Next, a [[crocodile]], an [[alligator]] and a [[caiman]] lie in the water. Taras hides behind Anna when he sees the [[python]]. Then they watch pink [[flamingos|flamingo]] and funny [[lemurs|lemur]]. A guide explains each animal's natural [[habitat]]. At the end, they buy hot dogs at the [[snack bar]].
